vectors.name: nonce_preparation_request
vectors.description: Nonce Preparation request for a new or recomputed session: SESSION_ID of 4 bytes of 0x51 without a LENGTH prefix, SESSION_REF absent (PRESENCE 0x00), MAX_INPUTS 2, DERIVATION_PATH m/86'/1'/0'/0/3 (CHILD_COUNT 5 and five 4-byte big-endian children), START 0 and END 1, each 4 bytes big-endian.

vectors.name: nonce_preparation_request_with_session_ref
vectors.description: Nonce Preparation request extending a held session: SESSION_ID of 4 bytes of 0x51, SESSION_REF present (PRESENCE 0x01 then 4 bytes of 0x52), MAX_INPUTS 2, DERIVATION_PATH m/86'/1'/0'/0/3, START 2 and END 3.

vectors.name: nonce_preparation_response
vectors.description: Nonce Preparation ok response: SESSION_ID (4 bytes of 0x51), SESSION_REF (4 bytes of 0x52, no PRESENCE byte), MAX_INPUTS 2, START 2 and END 3, then NONCES with COUNT 4 (two key expressions times two inputs), each a 66-byte NONCE without a LENGTH prefix, ordered by key expression index then input index: expression 2 input 0 with NONCE of 0x22, expression 2 input 1 with NONCE of 0x55, expression 3 input 0 with NONCE of 0x66, and expression 3 input 1 with NONCE of 0x77.
